note: plain text stays
leading spaces stay (nothing is trimmed)
U+0009 tab becomes a space
U+000A line feed becomes a space
U+000D carriage return becomes a space
U+0007 bell and U+007F delete become spaces
U+0085 next line, a C1 control, becomes a space
U+001B escape with no sequence after it becomes a space
U+200B zero width space is removed
U+202E right-to-left override is removed
U+00AD soft hyphen and U+FEFF byte order mark are removed
U+E0041 tag latin capital letter A, written as the surrogate pair DB40 DC41, is removed
U+061C arabic letter mark is removed
U+115F hangul choseong filler and U+1160 hangul jungseong filler are removed
U+200E left-to-right mark and U+200F right-to-left mark are removed
U+2028 line separator and U+2029 paragraph separator are removed
U+2060 word joiner and U+206F nominal digit shapes, the ends of their range, are removed
U+3164 hangul filler is removed
U+FFA0 halfwidth hangul filler is removed
U+E0000 and U+E007F cancel tag, the ends of the tag block, written as the surrogate pairs DB40 DC00 and DB40 DC7F, are removed
U+200D zero width joiner stays: emoji sequences need it
U+200C zero width non-joiner stays: scripts such as Devanagari need it
U+2027 hyphenation point, just below the U+2028 to U+202E range, stays
U+2070 superscript zero, just above the U+2060 to U+206F range, stays
U+E0080, just above the tag block, written as the surrogate pair DB40 DC80, stays
other scripts and accents stay
CSI colour sequences (U+001B [) are removed
a CSI that clears the screen is removed
a one-byte CSI (U+009B) sequence is removed
an OSC ended by BEL (U+0007) is removed
OSC 8 hyperlinks ended by ST (U+001B \) are removed
a two-character ESC sequence (ESC c) is removed
